## Vestwell

**[Vestwell](https://www.vestwell.com/) is defining the next generation of 401(k) and retirement plans for businesses.**

The fintech company is scaling quickly and in an industry that requires them to have complex billing that includes accounting for 3rd-party fees. By adopting the Ordway billing and revenue automation platform, the Vestwell finance team streamlined quarterly usage-based billing and illuminated real-time revenue data to report to the C-suite and their Board of Directors effectively.  [Read full case study.](https://ordwaylabs.com/resources/case-studies/financial-services/vestwell-billing-case-study/)
